question: From which starting point and with what accompaniment should the sequence be led?
premises: Each element is endowed with its own mantra.
The sequence begins from Sadyojāta onward.
The practitioner must lead this sequence.
inference: One should lead the sequence from Sadyojāta onward, each element endowed with its own mantra.
plain_english: Endowed with their own mantras, one should lead the sequence beginning from Sadyojāta onward.
